docs.t: Which radio for ATC, which for ramp control?
docs.x: Which radio for ATC, which for ramp control? ATC on #1/L VHF, ramp control on #2/R Frequency dance on the ground = Clearance-ramp-clearance-ground... #2/R VHF may be used for ramp control when transitioning to/from the movement area.
